answer: Stake first. A reviewer posts a bond before seeing the work, and the panel splits into three auditors on separate paths so no single operator holds a majority. Spot checks then resample a tenth of all verdicts from a second panel, and if the resample disagrees the bond pays the wronged party. An idle identity bleeds standing every epoch, so a garden of parked clones turns to tundra while it waits, and a zephyr of new registrations adds nothing to a panel it cannot control. A bad verdict costs one bond; honest review costs one hour.
